reviews.t: Be Aware!!!
reviews.x: Please note that Intuit Quickbooks now charges a monthly service fee for Enhanced Payroll, so even though you buy the enhanced payroll you still have to pay this additional fee each month to use the service. The minimum monthly fee is $2 for a company of 1 and goes up by that amount for each additional employee. Rates do get cheaper for larger companies. They always figure out a way to suck more money out of us every year.

reviews.t: Tax Break

They update the program every year, but most of the update don't really add an value for me fo

reviews.t: Super fast computer runs QuickBooks like slow legacy software
reviews.x: So I bought the software mainly for the 1-year payroll subscription which I do every year because it's cheaper to buy a new software package than to renew directly from Intuit. Saves me about $200, go figure? Regarding the 2018 version I wish this QuickBooks was optimized better. I have a 16GB DDR4 RAM computer with Ryzen chip and SSD so why does QuickBooks load and feel so slow. Everything else flies on this computer: I mean if it can game, it should be able to do accounting...

reviews.t: Causes you to pay per employee for payroll
reviews.x: QuickBooks Payroll is a great product but this package makes you change from one annual payment for payroll services to paying monthly per employee.  This results in a much greater cost for many payroll subscribers and monthly reporting to Intuit.  The payroll part of this product was basically worthless to me as we chose to continue our annual subscription fee rather than having to pay monthly and upload records.

reviews.t: LICENSE & PRODUCT Numbers Don't Work
reviews.x: I bought this new through Amazon, not a Seller.  It wouldn't install, saying the License and Product Numbers were incorrect.  After calling QB Tech Support (884-260-7006) I was told that when buying on Amazon it is likely a pirated product since the License & Product don't sync, and they wanted $500.00 for a year of Tech Support JUST to sync it and make it work.  Quite a racket.

claims.text: Buying the desktop software with a year of payroll included is cheaper than an annual payroll subscription.
Activating the payroll license or subscription is a frustrating, time-consuming ordeal, often requiring long phone calls.
Intuit's tech support is widely criticized as poor or unhelpful.
The software itself is good, user-friendly, and stable once working.
Customers complain about Intuit's marketing and billing practices, including extra monthly fees and forced renewals.
